scope.operation: model a bank-qualified player-Tech animation package source without installing it

canonical_spans.name: pc_action_config_reader
canonical_spans.role: AE93 times seven reads one fixed-bank CD player action-config row

canonical_spans.name: pc_tech_package_reader
canonical_spans.role: selector resolves through CD5EF0 and descriptor plus direct scripts resolve in fixed bank CE

canonical_spans.name: candidate_tail_transfer_site
canonical_spans.role: instruction-aligned LDA 9877 plus ASL A span that could hold a four-byte JML; candidate only, not approved

canonical_spans.name: pc_tech_package_resolver_parser_core
canonical_spans.role: fixed CD root resolver, fixed CE descriptor reads, and fixed CE direct-script bank installation before the tail JMP

canonical_spans.name: command_1e_1f_handlers
canonical_spans.role: command 1E enters a pointer selected from fixed bank CE and command 1F restores the parent pointer

canonical_spans.name: tech_animation_pointer_table
canonical_spans.role: 128 little-endian bank-local descriptor roots; the next byte belongs to another table

namespace_contract.typed_identity: player command ID, PC action-config row, package selector, descriptor root, and script pointer remain separate
namespace_contract.required_mapping: a Schala action ID must resolve through a separately authored extended action-config record whose byte 0 explicitly selects a declared Epoch package selector
namespace_contract.selector_90_policy: undeclared-and-refused; numeric equality to Focus Pulse action ID 90 creates no package mapping
namespace_contract.selector_ff_policy: undeclared-and-refused; the separate action-ID FF menu reservation is not imported as package-selector evidence

package_source_contract.identity: selector plus explicit package bank plus 16-bit descriptor root
package_source_contract.unbound_representation: absence of a PackageSource object; zero is never interpreted as free or unbound
package_source_contract.canonical_selector_policy: 00-7F resolve to bank CE and the hash-pinned canonical CD5EF0 roots in memory only
package_source_contract.extended_selector_policy: candidate Epoch package selectors 80-8F require an explicit PackageSource and a nonempty allocation name; no action ID maps there automatically
package_source_contract.current_extended_source_kind: synthetic-test-only; project-epoch-source is refused until a versioned contract names an approved allocation catalog entry
package_source_contract.descriptor_size: 4 plus two bytes for every set bit across both masks
package_source_contract.direct_script_pointer: little-endian 16-bit offset that inherits the PackageSource bank
package_source_contract.runtime_pointer_publication: 16-bit script offset at 5DBD plus owner*4 and 16-bit bank word at 5DBF plus owner*4
package_source_contract.bank_boundary_policy: the complete descriptor must remain inside one 64 KiB bank
package_source_contract.ffff_policy: descriptor roots and selected direct script offsets equal to FFFF are refused by the host model

nested_script_contract.canonical_behavior: C156E7 reads the indexed subscript pointer from fixed bank CE and C156ED installs bank CE
nested_script_contract.reason: a bank-qualified initial package reader alone does not make command 1E cross-bank safe
nested_script_contract.required_before_use: complete command-stream decode or an independently proved bank-aware subscript table and handler, exact preimages, vanilla equivalence, and runtime replay
nested_script_contract.command_1f_status: restores the previously saved 24-bit parent script pointer but does not repair command 1E selection

auxiliary_config_contract.config_byte_3: C145F3 reads fixed D1:0060 and C14870 later forces decompression source bank D1
auxiliary_config_contract.config_byte_4: C145FF reads fixed CD:692C; command 60 and the tile-animation tick retain fixed CD/D1 consumers
auxiliary_config_contract.config_byte_5: C1460B reads fixed CD:656E; C148EC-C14943 and later frame readers retain fixed CE consumers
auxiliary_config_contract.policy: an expanded primary script does not make original graphics or auxiliary-frame data bank-safe; each extended config must temporarily use proved canonical auxiliary selectors or wait for separately proved adapters

architecture_recommendation.canonical_00_7f: preserve the canonical resolver and loader path; use the host model only to prove its bank/root identities and future equivalence
architecture_recommendation.epoch_80_8f: intercept only explicitly declared Epoch package selectors and resolve a compact named bank-qualified source table
architecture_recommendation.canonical_root_duplication: forbidden; do not copy the 128-word canonical resolver into Project Epoch expanded data
architecture_recommendation.high_selector_failure: refuse before any indirect read or runtime pointer publication when no explicit PackageSource exists
architecture_recommendation.hook_selection: unresolved; the four-byte candidate span is evidence for design, not approval

candidate_helper_abi.canonical_branch: for selector 00-7F, re-execute LDA 9877 and ASL A then JML to untouched C14616
candidate_helper_abi.entry_widths: M=0 and X=0; 16-bit accumulator and 16-bit X/Y
candidate_helper_abi.stack_policy: preserve the original indirect-JSR return frame and return with a balanced stack
candidate_helper_abi.required_inputs: WRAM 9877 selector word with high byte zero, A0B3 alternate-list flag byte with adjacent high byte zero, and the already populated action-config block
candidate_helper_abi.a0b3_input_contract: strict 00-FF with adjacent high byte zero; 00 selects mask0 and nonzero selects mask1
candidate_helper_abi.required_outputs: 16-bit 9878/9879 descriptor root, big-endian masks in DP 80-83, 16-bit owner activation at 5DAC plus owner, and 16-bit bank-qualified direct pointers at 5DBD/5DBF plus owner*4
candidate_helper_abi.exit_widths: M=1 and X=0 with D=0000 and DBR=7E
candidate_helper_abi.expanded_exit_state: X equals consumed-list cursor, Y=0010, DP 80-81 consumed to zero, DP 82-83 preserve mask1, A and B are zero, stack balanced, and A0B3 is cleared after an alternate-list pass
candidate_helper_abi.flags_policy: preserve I, D, and V; characterize remaining exit flags before runtime promotion
candidate_helper_abi.scratch_policy: no WRAM or direct-page scratch is approved

upstream_reconnaissance.licensed_wrapper_observation: the Python wrapper allocates separate 256-entry bank and local-root tables
upstream_reconnaissance.embedded_routine_provenance: the wrapper calls its opaque machine-code payload Mauron's patch; no separate Mauron license or source provenance was found
upstream_reconnaissance.adoption_policy: architectural lead only; independently reconstruct semantics and import no embedded machine bytes, copied canonical table payload, allocator choice, or hook

limitations: The model proves only bank-qualified package roots and direct descriptor entries.
It does not decode animation command streams or certify that an expanded script avoids command 1E.
It does not adapt the fixed D1, CD, and CE auxiliary graphics, tile-animation, or frame-data readers selected by PC action-config bytes 3 through 5.
It selects no expanded ROM bank, allocation, WRAM scratch, hook, interrupt policy, or assembler implementation.
Canonical selector equivalence is a host-side read-only result, not an emulator replay.
No menu, battle, save, load, New Game+, teardown, or logical PC 07 runtime path is proved.
nonclaims: No eighth playable character is installed.
No Schala Tech animation package is authored or bound.
No Schala action ID is mapped to a same-numbered package selector.
No canonical pointer table bytes are source-controlled or emitted.
No upstream patch bytes are licensed, copied, disassembled, or installed.
No ROM location is declared free and the trusted production hook and allocation catalogs remain empty.
